dishes.name: Smoky Bean Harvest Bowls
dishes.title: Smoky three-bean chilli with brown rice
dishes.method: Assemble your bowl by taking a portion of the warm beans and rice directly from the pots. Garnish with a handful of fresh coriander.
dishes.why: This dish uses smoky chipotle and slow-simmered beans to meet the house request for deep flavours while remaining vegan and sesame-safe.

dishes.name: Zesty Chipotle Pepper Pots
dishes.title: Reheated smoky beans with charred sweetcorn and lime
dishes.method: Reheat the beans and rice in a pan with a splash of water until piping hot. Stir in the sweetcorn to warm through and finish with a fresh squeeze of lime.
dishes.why: The citrus and corn provide a fresh contrast to the slow-cooked base, ensuring dinner feels distinct from lunch.

preparations.title: Smoky Three-Bean Chilli
preparations.method: Finely chop the onions and peppers. Sauté in olive oil until softened. Add minced garlic and spices, stirring for one minute. Pour in the tomatoes and beans (with their liquid). Simmer on low heat for 30 minutes until thick and smoky.

preparations.title: Steamed Brown Rice
preparations.method: Rinse the rice and place in a pot with double the volume of water. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low for 25-30 minutes until tender. Let it stand covered for 5 minutes before fluffing.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Start the rice on the hob first as it takes the longest to simmer. While it cooks, chop your onions and peppers for the chilli. Sauté the vegetables and get the chilli simmering in a second pot. Once both are finished, portion them out into the named boxes for the day's meals.

member_portions.portion_note: Serve the peppers and onions first, then the smoky beans, with the brown rice on the side.
